title: Tailwind CSS
tagline: Build interfaces from a systematic vocabulary of composable utilities
summary: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework for constructing interfaces from small, composable classes. This book explains the ideas underneath utility-first design, how Tailwind generates styles, responsive and state variants, layout, typography, color, customization, themes, components, accessibility, React integration, performance, and production architecture. The goal is to understand Tailwind as a design and build system rather than memorize class names.
